items.title: 71231_Sam Wooding Oral History Interview
items.q: We saw the rise of Louis Armstrong and Earl Hines, you know what I mean? And heard his first number on scat singing

ctx.x: I meant musically. Were you keeping up with the development in music?

Oh, yes. We used to hear over [there] from people coming backward and forward, and getting letters from home. And all like that. What was going on. We saw the rise of Louis Armstrong and Earl Hines, you know what I mean? And heard his first number on scat singing, you know? (sings) And he'd say, instead of saying, (unintelligible). And we knew that the Savoy was going and what Chick Webb was doing a good job and all like that. But, still, they had to catch us. Because when we left there, we were the first.
